questions.question: You have led large mortgage-operations teams through high-volume production, quality, and regulatory requirements. How would you apply that leadership experience to building and managing a team of data engineers and data scientists?
Describe a time at Chase or Wingspan when you used operational reporting and production metrics to identify a problem, implement a process change, and measure the outcome.

This role requires translating organizational strategy into a future-state data architecture and technology roadmap. How have you translated business objectives into operational plans, procedures, or systems changes in your previous roles?

What experience do you have working with data systems such as Oracle, mainframe platforms, Fiserv, Lakewood, LPS Desktop, or imaging systems, and how did you use information from those systems to support decisions or operations?

The organization needs data warehouses and analytics capabilities to support product and business teams. How would you approach gathering requirements from stakeholders and defining the data, reporting, and operational needs for an analytics solution?
Describe your experience developing procedures, training materials, or operating instructions for a new team or process. How did you ensure the process was adopted consistently?

In your Chase role, you helped start an REO quality department and provided feedback on the company database. What issues did you identify, how did you communicate them to stakeholders, and what changes resulted?

This position is hands-on and involves close partnership with product development, engineering, DevOps/DataOps, and business teams. Give an example of how you worked across teams with different priorities to resolve an operational or customer-impacting issue.

Data governance is important in a healthcare-focused organization. Drawing on your experience with mortgage regulations, quality controls, and risk analysis, how would you establish accountability for data quality, documentation, access, and compliance?

The role requires adopting technologies such as cloud data platforms, ETL/ELT pipelines, SQL, Spark, Kubernetes, and machine learning. What is your current level of technical exposure to these technologies, and how would you build the hands-on capability needed to lead this function?
